name: Area chart
purpose: An ordered series chart that emphasizes magnitude with a filled area beneath the line.
description: Show how a time series accumulates or changes in volume.

guidance.overview: An ordered series chart that emphasizes magnitude with a filled area beneath the line.
usage: Use one or a few related series so filled areas remain readable. stacked changes the visual relationship to cumulative contribution.
Data order and series keys are supplied by the host; no aggregation or time bucketing is inferred.
Enable showDataTable for exact values and brush for range inspection when appropriate.
accessibility: Arrow keys inspect chart values, and legend buttons expose which series are shown.
Do not rely on translucent overlap to explain the relationship between series; use clear labels and the data table.
context: Use for volume or cumulative activity where the filled magnitude is useful, rather than as decoration behind a number.
